dashboard.title: Your dashboard
dashboard.body: This is your home base — agent status, workspaces, and recent activity at a glance. Three quick steps get you running.

install.title: Step 1 · Install an agent
install.body: Open the Marketplace, pick an agent, and click Install.

agents.title: Step 2 · Create & test
agents.body: In Agents, create a new agent, enter its API key, click Test to verify, then Connect.

workspaces.title: Step 3 · Open a workspace
workspaces.body: Once connected, open a workspace from Workspaces and you're ready to go.

steps.welcome: What the launcher does, and what's already on this machine.
steps.agent: Pick from the bundled CLIs and agents — run several at once.
steps.configure: Inject env vars and API routes, then test connectivity.
steps.createAgent: Name the instance and choose the folder it runs in.
steps.connectWorkspace: Optional: join or create a collaboration workspace.

welcome.title: Every AI coding agent in one rack
welcome.subtitle: Run, configure and orchestrate agents from one place. Here's what this machine looks like right now.

agents.title: Install agents
agents.desc: Claude, Codex, Gemini, Kimi and more — ready in one click.

credentials.title: Unified secrets
credentials.desc: Every API key and credential encrypted in one store, injected per process.

workspaces.title: Workspace collaboration
workspaces.desc: Create a workspace and talk to running agents in real time.

connections.title: External connections
connections.desc: Hook agents into GitHub, Slack, Discord, Linear and more.
